name: Sidney Resources Corp.
summary: Sidney Resources Corporation engages in the acquisition, exploration, and production of gold and silver properties. The company owns interests in the Lucky Ben Mine Group properties consisting of 3 patented claims covering approximately 53 acres and 2 unpatented claims totaling approximately 80 acres located in the Warren Mining District in Central Idaho, the United States. Sidney Resources Corporation was founded in 1896 and is based in Lewiston, Idaho.
